findings.message: Rule-bearing legacy code in Payroll.Rules.overtimeRule matches no observation and cites no authority: decimal literal 44.0 (line 8); decimal literal 1.5 (line 8). Value 44 equals DEC-PY01.p1 (superseded by DEC-PY06). Value 1.5 equals DEC-PY01.p2 (superseded by DEC-PY06). Value 1.5 equals DEC-PY06.p2 (accepted). The code still carries a superseded decision's value. Question for People Operations: which accepted record, if any, authorizes it? New work must not reuse it until answered; the legacy code is left unchanged.
